name: notion
purpose: Pages and databases in the person's Notion workspace

apiKey.help: notion.so/my-integrations → New integration → copy the secret; then share the pages it may read with the integration

guide:
The Notion API (https://developers.notion.com/reference), as the person's integration. Every request needs the header `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`.

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://api.notion.com/v1/search -H 'Notion-Version: 2022-06-28' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"roadmap","page_size":10}'
curl -s https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/PAGE_ID/children -H 'Notion-Version: 2022-06-28'
curl -s -X POST https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/DB_ID/query -H 'Notion-Version: 2022-06-28' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"page_size":20}'
```

Creating or editing a page asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
